messages:
rachel-cs: FYI acme reported that after the model v2026-03-17 push, their rerank endpoint returns different ordering for identical inputs.
acme-integration: Repro on our side: same query+docs, two runs 30s apart. Previously top doc stayed #1, now fluctuates.
sam-ml: can you paste the exact request (no PII) and scores? also which model id?
acme-integration: model: redwood/rerank-v3-quant
Request:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "query": "best wireless earbuds", "candidates": ["A","B","C","D"] }
```
Run A scores: [0.87, 0.82, 0.80, 0.79]
Run B scores: [0.85, 0.86, 0.81, 0.78]
Order changed: A,B swapped to B,A
kai-runtime: any 5xxs or latency spikes around deploy time? logs?
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/rerank-v3-quant @ 2026-03-17T09:12Z succeeded
olivia-eng: i pulled logs — no 5xxs; but there are a handful of INFO lines: `kv_cache_mismatch` on some requests
sam-ml: kv cache mismatch could affect hidden state -> scoring. Also we changed a softmax temperature tweak in v3. Need deterministic repro with --no-kv-cache and same seed.
rachel-cs: acme willing to run repro. steps we want: 1) same request json 50x, 2) set request header `x-disable-kv: 1`, 3) include debug flag to return logits, 4) send to both old model variant and new. They can run this tomorrow.
kai-runtime: i'll enable a verbose trace for that customer for 2 hours and pin them to dedicated instance to rule out routing variants.
sam-ml: also ask for tokenized inputs: whitespace differences could change tokenization; include `raw_tokens` in debug output.
acme-integration: noted. one more: we hit an API rate-limiting `429` earlier when ramping tests — could that affect caching/ordering? 
kai-runtime: 429s shouldn't change scores but can produce retries which could hit different backend shards. We'll check routing logs.
olivia-eng: quick hypothesis: quantization kernel branch + kv-cache + batching reorder -> non-deterministic float rounding. We'll try re-running with deterministic quant path.
sam-ml: plan: collect 50 runs with and without kv, on v2 (prev stable) and v3, include logits + tokenization. we'll reconvene once we have the dump. :thumbsup:
